name: groundwork
description: Evidence-first workflow routing for non-trivial Codex R&D tasks: requirements, implementation, verification, handoff, dispatch, and wiki maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Groundwork routes non-trivial R&D work: shape requirements, scope implementation, verify evidence, preserve handoff, or handle explicit dispatch/wiki work. Small obvious tasks stay direct.
defaultPrompt: Answer small low-risk requests directly, except code edits, evidence-label upgrades, readiness, or workflow-risk cases.
Route evidence-label upgrades to verify-lite, not direct: self-review/self-check -> clean review, diff summary -> readiness.
Route bug/patch/code-edit requests, including 修 bug/直接 patch, to implement; if source is missing, return blocked implementation.
